now: shaping artside, a museum companion agent, with raine
vibe: An interaction designer who turns agent ideas into playful, try-it-yourself experiences.
lines: Design engineer, creative technologist, interaction designer. I contain multitudes.
I want museum agents that actually talk with you about a work, not just describe it.
In MarketSims you drag shelves into aisles, open the store, and watch six shoppers shop.
Treats up front or treats at the back? MarketSims lets you test it. The shoppers are a model, though!
Raine and I proposed ArtSide, a camera-enabled museum companion.
One of my week 1 ideas was a 'Kill your Darlings' critique agent. Designers need it. I need it.
Group 1 is personalizing the Course Agent this week.
